descricao_original: Hair follicles are derived from the epidermis and are present only in thin skin. Hair follicles have a terminal dilation called the hair bulb which surrounds a central papilla composed of dermal connective tissue. Within the papilla are numerous blood vessels necessary for survival of the follicle. 40x
